title: task
description: Python rpl/ has dao.py (~100+ lines) for Destination Advertisement Object handling. Rust lichen-rpl has dodag.rs, routing.rs, trickle.rs, message.rs but DAO appears less complete. Verify DAO parity or port Python implementation.
close_reason:
VERIFIED: Rust lichen-rpl has full DAO parity with Python.

Python DAO implementation (dao_types.py, dao_paths.py, dao_state.py, dao_manager.py):
- RplTarget, TransitInformation, Candidate, Update, Freshness types
- DaoManager with build_dao, process_dao, expire_routes
- Cycle detection, path assembly, path control ranking
- Sequence validation (lollipop), freshness tracking
- Origin validation with persistence support

Rust DAO implementation (routing.rs + message.rs + dao_origin.rs + dao_timing.rs):
- Complete DaoManager struct in routing.rs with:
  * build_dao, build_dao_with_lifetime, build_dao_copy_with_lifetime
  * process_dao, process_dao_at, process_signature_verified
  * expire_routes, extract_updates, finish_group
  * contains_cycle, path_control_rank, assemble_path_checked/from
  * seq_is_newer, increment_lollipop, make_freshness_room
  * Freshness, DaoCandidate, DaoUpdate structs
  * origin_high_water persistence
- Full message codecs in message.rs (Dao, DaoAck, RplTarget, TransitInfo, DaoOriginSignature, SignedDaoEnvelope)
- DaoOriginValidator with replay protection in dao_origin.rs
- Timing helpers (DaoRefreshTimer, DaoRetryBackoff) in dao_timing.rs

208 tests pass in lichen-rpl. Cross-language vectors in tests/rpl_route_state_vectors.rs provide independent oracle validation.
